messages.subject: SECR Question
parts:
Hello,

I was curious to see if anyone has had any experience with spatially explicit capture-recapture methods that utilize acoustic detections, primarily from callback responses to a broadcasted call. We are dealing with a farily cryptic avian species that is generally impossible to detect visually (other than by random chance), is relatively sparse in its distribution, and does not reliably produce calls for any extended period of time. However, this species does respond fairly well to broadcasted calls, and general locations can be derived from this. I am looking into methods for trying to determine density of this species and thought that SECR methods may provide a way to accomplish this.

Any information or guidance anyone could offer would be most welcome. I know this creates another complication in an already complicated method, but wanted to see if it might be possible.

Thanks,

John Edwards


John Edwards
Ph.D. Research Assistant
